newsitem.title: USA: May Davis driving to oust NetLive board.
newsitem.headline: May Davis driving to oust NetLive board.

text.p: May Davis Group Inc said Monday it plans to launch a drive to solicit the consents of NetLive Communcations Inc shareholders for the removal of NetLive's board of directors and elect a new board.
It said it made a demand for a list of NetLive's shareholders on February 28 as part of its plans.
May Owen, a spokesman for May Davis, said the aim of its action was "to maximize shareholder value."
May Davis, which undrwrote NetLive's initial public offering in August, said it intends to select nominees for the NetLive board.
